propositions: The query ticket digest is re-sent verbatim in the user message on every overlap judge call within a batch, occupying the volatile block and bypassing the cache.
Relocating the query digest from the per-call user message to the system prompt places it in the cacheable prefix, enabling cache hits on the remaining N-1 calls of a review.

The measured system prefix after hoisting (846 tokens) falls short of the real Anthropic floor for claude-sonnet-4-6 (1024 tokens measured), resulting in zero cache writes and a net +936 token regression (+5.8%).
Ordered-pair semantics are preserved under hoisting by passing a keyword-only argument ('first' or 'second') to indicate which side of the pair carries the hoisted reference.
Precision on the overlap judge is not degraded by the relocation: 12 of 12 ordered-pair relations remain identical between baseline and hoisted implementations.
